blocks.text: Doppler effect electromagnetic waves par bhi lagu hota hai. Is ka ek aham istemal radar system hai, jo hawai jahaz ki bulandi aur speed maloom karne ke liye radio waves istemal karta hai. RADAR (RAdio Detection And Ranging) radio waves bhejne aur wasool karne wala aala hai. Agar hawai jahaz radar ki taraf aaye to jahaz se lautti wave ki wavelength chhoti, aur door jaye to lambi hoti hai (Fig. 7.13 a, b). Isi tarah Zameen ke gird ghoomte satellites ki speed bhi isi usool se maloom ki ja sakti hai.

SONAR Sound Navigation And Ranging se bana mukhaffaf (acronym) hai. Yeh pani ke neeche sonic ya ultrasonic goonj (echo) se faasla aur gehrai napne wale nizamon ka aam naam hai, pani ke neeche cheezon ki maujoodgi awaz ki goonj se pata karne ki technique. Sonar mein Doppler detection target aur detector ki nisbati speed par munhasir hai ta ke target ki speed ka andaza mile, Doppler effect istemal karte hue, jis mein source aur observer ki nisbati harkat se frequency mein zahiri tabdeeli hoti hai. Is ke maloom fauji istemalat mein submarines ka pata lagana aur jagah maloom karna, antisubmarine hathiyaron ka control, mines dhoondna, aur samandar ki gehrai napna shamil hain.

Astronomers door ke sitaron aur galaxies ki speed nikalne ke liye Doppler effect istemal karte hain: sitare ki light ke line spectrum ka laboratory source ki light se muwazna kar ke sitare ki light ka Doppler shift napa jata hai aur phir sitare ki speed nikali jati hai.

items: Zameen se door jate sitare red shift dikhate hain (Fig. 7.14b): nikalti waves ki wavelength aaram wale sitare se lambi hai, to spectrum lambi wavelength, yaani spectrum ke surkh sire, ki taraf khisak jata hai. Astronomers ne daryaft kiya hai ke tamam door ki galaxies hum se door ja rahi hain, aur un ke red shift nap kar un ki speed ka andaza lagaya hai.

Zameen ki taraf aate sitare blue shift dikhate hain (Fig. 7.14c), kyunke sitare ki nikali light ki wavelength aaram wale sitare se chhoti hai, to spectrum chhoti wavelength, yaani spectrum ke neele sire, ki taraf khisak jata hai.

Radar speed trap: transmitter se microwaves chhote jhatkon (bursts) mein nikalti hain; har jhatka microwaves ke raste mein kisi gari se laut aata hai, aur jhatkon ke darmiyan transmitter lautti microwaves pakarne ke liye khula hota hai. Agar lautna kisi chalti rukawat se ho to lautti microwaves Doppler shifted hoti hain, aur Doppler shift nap kar computer programme gari ki speed nikalta hai.

Satellite navigation satellite ki velocity aur position maloom karne ke liye Doppler shift istemal karti hai, jis se durust location tracking mumkin hai; satellite communication mustaqil signals ke liye Doppler shift ki talafi (compensation) karti hai.
Doppler radar hawa ki velocity aur barish ke patterns pakarta hai; Doppler shift Zameen ki sath ki velocity aur bigaar (deformation) napne mein bhi madad deta hai.

Doppler echocardiography khoon ke bahao ki velocity napti hai aur dil ki kharabiyan jaise valve ki tangi (stenosis) ya ulta bahao (regurgitation) pakarti hai, aur pacemaker ki settings behtar karne mein madad deti hai; Doppler ultrasound khoon ka bahao napta hai, cardiac output nikalta hai, aur nason ki tangi ya bandish pakarta hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.12
blocks.text: Ek dhundli galaxy ke absorption spectrum ki ek line, jise Ca-alpha line pehchana gaya, ki wavelength 478 nm payi gayi; laboratory mein isi line ki napi wavelength 397 nm hai. (a) Kya galaxy Zameen ki taraf aa rahi hai ya door ja rahi hai? (b) Zameen ke nisbat galaxy ki speed nikalein. Hal: lambda = 397 nm = 397 x 10^-9 m (laboratory), lambda' = 478 nm = 478 x 10^-9 m (zahiri), c = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1. (a) Chunke v = f lambda aur v = c, f = c/lambda = 3 x 10^8 / 397 x 10^-9 = 7.56 x 10^14 Hz (laboratory frequency); zahiri frequency f' = c/lambda' = 3 x 10^8 / 478 x 10^-9 = 6.28 x 10^14 Hz. Chunke lambda' lambda se bari, ya f' f se kam hai, galaxy Zameen se door ja rahi hai. (b) f' = (v/(v + u_s)) f = (c/(c + u_s)) f; qeematein rakhne par 6.28 x 10^14 = (3 x 10^8/(3 x 10^8 + u_s)) x 7.56 x 10^14, to 3 x 10^8 + u_s = 3 x 10^8 x 7.56 x 10^14 / 6.28 x 10^14, u_s = 22.68 x 10^8/6.28 - 3 x 10^8 = 6.12 x 10^7 m s^-1.

blocks.prompt: Insanon mein dil ke masail parhne ke liye Doppler effect kaise lagu karenge (short question 7.6)? Ek galaxy 0.2 c par door ja rahi hai; aam taur par 500 nm par nikalne wali spectral line kitni wavelength par dikhegi, kitab ka formula istemal karte hue (Galactic Motion box)?
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound dil aur khoon ki nalyon mein bheja jata hai; chalte surkh khoon ke khaliye (red blood cells) use lautate hain aur woh Doppler shifted wapas aata hai, shift khoon ke bahao ki speed aur simt batata hai, to tang (stenosed) ya risne wale (regurgitant) valves, band nalyan aur cardiac output nape ja sakte hain. f' = (c/(c + u_s)) f aur lambda = c/f se lambda' = lambda (c + u_s)/c = 500 x 1.2 = 600 nm, 100 nm ka red shift.

items: Electromagnetic aur sound waves ka Doppler shift: radar (jahaz aur satellites), sonar (submarines, mines, samandar ki gehrai), astronomy (door jate ka red shift, qareeb aate ka blue shift; tamam door ki galaxies door ja rahi hain), radar speed traps, satellite navigation aur rabta, weather radar, echocardiography aur Doppler ultrasound.
Example 7.12: 397 nm ke muqable 478 nm, f' f se kam, galaxy 6.12 x 10^7 m s^-1 se door ja rahi hai.
